Name: Granny Eun's Portraits for SVE
Author: GrannyEun
Description:
This mod features a new look for all SVE character portraits, including their beach and winter portraits! These portraits are a bit stylized and feature a semi-realistic look. If you are using this mod in addition to my vanilla portraits, please download the compatible version of that in order for it to work with this mod. I hope you enjoy!

6/11/2024 Portraiture is LIVE! This should make things so much easier for many of you, hopefully. This version obviously requires Portraiture, hence why I added it to the requirements. It does not require, PyTK Lite, however! Works awesome without it!

8/16/2025 I found a work-around for the vendor portraits not working in game, but it will require a download of DolphinIsNotaFish's They Deserve It Too - Portraits for Vendors. See below for detailed instructions on how to add this to your game.

How to Install:﻿[/u]

Portraiture Version (Recommended):

Navigate to your "Stardew Valley/Mods/Portraiture/Portraits" folder. Drag and drop the "GrannyEun" folder into the Portraits folder. Launch your game using SMAPI. When in a dialogue conversation, press the "p" button to change the portrait.

Content Patcher Version:

Drag and drop the folder [CP] Granny Eun's SVE Portraits wherever you have your Mods folder located. My mods folder looks like this: C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods.

I recommend using PyTK Lite, I have not tested this mod with the original PyTK. 

[u]FOR VENDOR PORTAITS:

[/u]Download DolphinIsNotaFish's Portraits for Vendors mod (linked above).

In the files tab of my SVE portraits mod, download the optional file titled GrannyEun's Vendor Portraits for SVE.

Navigate to your "Stardew Valley/Mods/PortraitsforVendors" folder.

Unzip GrannyEun's Vendor Portraits for SVE. Click and drag the folder titled [CP] Portraits for Vendors into the Portraits for Vendors folder to overwrite it.
